title: A mainnet transaction that ends txINTERNAL_ERROR
pattern: stellar-core threw while applying a Soroban call: the result is txINTERNAL_ERROR, the fee is charged and no operation has metadata. Before protocol 23 the unused fee still comes back, in txChangesAfter.

hazards.placement: txINTERNAL_ERROR at apply, a mainnet Soroban call
the refund of a txINTERNAL_ERROR transaction, before protocol 23

facts.says: stellar-core threw while applying the transaction: the result is txINTERNAL_ERROR.
The fee charged, after the refund below, is 555,036 stroops.
The metadata has no operation entries.
The unused fee comes back in txChangesAfter (2 changes), not in an operation.
Before the refund the source account holds 2,719,687,106 stroops.
